title: Global Running Day | OneSliders
metaDescription: Global Running Day brings people around the world together through running and movement each June.
topicSummary: Running, outdoor movement and active ways to reset.

overview.about: Global Running Day is a worldwide celebration of running, encouraging people of all ages and abilities to get moving on the same day. Held on the first Wednesday of June, it uses a simple pledge-and-participate format to promote the health benefits of an active lifestyle.
overview.nextEvent: The next Global Running Day falls on the first Wednesday of June. Participants pledge to run any distance, join local group runs or share their effort online, making it an accessible entry point to the sport.

participationIntro: Take part by making running accessible and social:

participationSteps.text: Go for a short run, jog or walk-run at a level that fits your body.
Invite someone who might not normally join a running activity.
Use a safe route, visible clothing and realistic pacing.
Share the run or join a local group event if one is available.
